meta.comment: Business-rule gate for silver.fact_order_payments. Composite PK (order_id, payment_sequential). Quarantine already drops rows with null PK or unparseable payment_value.

unknown payment_type breaks gold breakdowns by method
negative or absurd payment value corrupts gold revenue totals
0 installments valid for boleto/voucher; 24 is Brazilian credit-card max; rare outliers tolerated
